rules: The adapter MUST execute against the real authorization boundary used by the application.
A mock-only authorization implementation MUST NOT produce SECURITY_GREEN evidence.
Payload Local API MUST NOT be treated as an implicit authorization bypass.
Every execution MUST generate request_id and trace_id.
Every case MUST record expected and actual decisions.
Race cases MUST execute with the registered concurrency level.
Missing or malformed evidence MUST fail the evidence gate.
The adapter MUST expose the active authorization, credential, membership, entitlement and delegation versions where applicable.
greenRule: SECURITY_GREEN requires real implementation execution plus complete PASS evidence for every applicable adversarial case.
